title: Magnetic Effects of Electric Current - Kid-friendly workshop quiz

modules.name: Current and magnetism

questions.question: What happens when current flows through a wire?
questions.explanation: A current-carrying wire creates a magnetic field around it.

questions.question: Which scientist showed the compass deflection near a wire?
questions.explanation: Oersted connected electricity and magnetism in the experiment.

modules.focus: Lines help us picture direction and strength.

modules.focus: Wire shape changes the magnetic pattern.

questions.explanation: A straight wire gives circular field lines.

modules.name: Safety
modules.focus: Protection against shocks, overloads, and short circuits.

questions.question: Which part protects a circuit from too much current?
questions.explanation: A fuse breaks the circuit when current gets too high.
